behavior.overview: Sorted physical item quantities for every current-stage item. One ordinary Button hit/focus host; decorative icons44/38/32/28/24/20px wrap without item cap. Caption14px outlined/shadowed with contrast backing. Craft badge=operations*yield.
behavior.glow: Published live matching bank/vendor/mail context; cached bank view is insufficient. Generic vendored glow only, resize on changed dimensions, stop on close/completion/waiting/combat. Paint never re-enters vendor readiness.
behavior.batch: Any icon area dispatches all this stage targets through scoped existing mail/bank/vendor owners. Join active owner without restart; no unrelated goal, duplicate submitted batch or craft/AH auto gesture.
behavior.automation: Character auctionRestock.autoFollowup defaults off; separate option in Loot & Items / Restock. Works with global auto flags on/off without changing them. Failed attempt retries only after bag generation/free slots/money change; submitted intent waits for stage progress.
behavior.price: Per-item noPriceLimit defaults on for new/oldzero. Old positive caps migrate off. Explicit off+zero blocks paid AH offers and paid parent recipe budgets. Ingredient AH caps do not change normal vendor policy. Mode persists/inherits and invalidates incompatible source plans.
behavior.allScan: Explicit Scan prices full/zero targets, vendor opportunities and newly visible/free-route ingredients; freshness invalidates changed paid-route comparisons. Automatic recovery remains shortage-scoped. Full weaker potion stock still discovers stronger usable tiers and updates saved tiers/full new target.
behavior.noClear: No Clear pending control; automatic authoritative mailbox reconciliation remains.
behavior.groupedPrices: Auctionator write-back availability uses grouped availableQuantity while a modern item bid remains physical1.
